medals.name: "I Dream of Honey Waffles"
medals.desc: You and Kay journeyed through a wondrous world of shrooms, honey waffles, and a healthy dollop of fantasy. Do not worry, and do not doubt. This is one true adventure.
medals.cond: Complete side mission [I Dream of Honey Waffles]

medals.name: "A Good Marriage Needs Good Kohl"
medals.desc: And with this, the groom and shroom... Is this even right? Can't we just call her the bride? Anyways, they lived happily ever after.

medals.name: "Despotic Brutality"
medals.desc: You have crushed the heavily armed despots and exposed their brutality upon the silverscreen.
medals.cond: In [Umbral Monument], complete all "Despot Weaponized" Difficulty Ⅲ stages
medals.trim: In [Umbral Monument], complete all "Despot Weaponized" Difficulty Ⅵ stages

medals.name: "Fungal Bounciness"
medals.desc: You seem to have experienced true fungal bounciness. It is quite wondrous, like playing on a trampoline.
medals.cond: Let the controlled operator get lifted ≥ 4 times from 1 round of the Shroomkrusher Sporeknuckles' continuous quake attack

medals.name: Shroom World Crate Master
medals.desc: You have opened most storage crates in Wuling. They are worth tons of honey waffles.
medals.cond: In the Old Dam, open 47 crates

medals.name: Dam Treader
medals.desc: Actually, you might know more about this dam than its original designers.
medals.cond: In the Old Dam, use Waffle Strike or operator attacks to interact with special shrooms (including: Power-Feeding Mushrooms, Rainbow Mushrooms, Mushroom Vines, and Delulu Walls) 20 times

medals.name: "Our Lives Rebuilt"
medals.desc: Remember the past. Welcome the future.
medals.cond: In Wuling, progress Exclusion Zone Rebuilding to Phase 4 (Routine Maintenance)

medals.name: "BEST! ARENA OF TALOS-II!"
medals.desc: In Wuling, a great arena that could truly ignite the warriors' passion for battle has reached its perfect conclusion! Have faith in us! Another great arena is in the works!
medals.cond: In [RISE! MEGA ARENA!], complete all stages on Normal mode
medals.trim:
In [RISE! MEGA ARENA!], complete these stages within 200s:
· [Yuanyuan! Open for Biz! MAXED!]
· [Fight! Wuling Ablaze! MAXED!]

medals.name: "Witchcraft 21"
medals.desc: You seem to be getting pretty good with the witchcraft pastime introduced by "Lucky Carrot".

medals.name: "Joker's Warlord Power"
medals.desc: And with that mighty explosion, the despotic Warlord finally fell... However, his legend continues to spread across all sorts of card tables.

medals.name: "Shroom City"
medals.desc: One by one you illuminated the fragmented Protocol Space. The City of Shrooms has opened its gates for you (and no, you are not hallucinating this time).
medals.cond: In [Delver of the Cryptic], complete all "Esoteric Mycology" Protocol Spaces
medals.trim: In [Delver of the Cryptic], perfectly complete all "Esoteric Mycology" Protocol Spaces

medals.name: "Come, Slither Out of the Pipes"
medals.desc: UWST tunnel and pipeline repair crews often run into nidwyrms. Baiting them out would be a great idea.
medals.secret: When the Shroomkrusher Nidwyrm is hiding, use honey waffles to lure it out of the ground

medals.name: "Professional Safe House"
medals.desc: A professional operator always has her safe house prepped before her operation. Never underestimate Kay's professionalism ... or lack thereof.
medals.secret: In the Old Dam, reach the Secret Base
